proposeChanges: Propose changes to this item. Your changes will be reviewed by moderators before being published.
communityEditedWarning: This item has community edits. You are editing the community-modified version.
reasonPlaceholder: Explain why you're making these changes... (e.g., 'Fixed incorrect damage value', 'Added missing French translation')
reasonHelp: Adding a reason helps moderators understand and approve your changes faster.
guidelineAccurate: Only submit accurate information from official sources
guidelineSpelling: Check your spelling and grammar in all languages
guidelineReview: Your submission will be reviewed by moderators before being published
guidelineTrack: You can track your submission status in your profile
translationTip: You don't need to fill all languages. Fill only the ones you know. Other contributors can add missing translations later.
iconFilenameHelp: Icon files are hosted on the CDN. Only change if you know the correct filename.
metadataNote: Leave fields empty if unknown. Moderators will verify all information before approval.
clickAddToStart: Click 'Add New Stat' below to add statistics to this item.
clickAddComponent: Click 'Add Component' to add crafting materials.

recycleOutputDesc: Components received when recycling this item
canBeObtainedDesc: Recycle these items to obtain this component
usedInCraftingDesc: This component is used in crafting these items
componentIdsTip: Component IDs should match existing items in the database. Use lowercase with underscores (e.g., steel_plate, electronic_component).
tagKeepReason: This item is valuable and should be kept
tagSellReason: This item has good value and can be sold
tagRecycleReason: This item should be recycled for materials
explainWhy: Explain why this tag is appropriate...
addQuestsHelp: Add quests that require this item.
addProjectsHelp: Add projects that require this item.

addReasonsWhyKeep: Add reasons why this item should be kept
buildChainsWhyRecycle: Build chains to show the recycling path for this item

targetItemNotFound: Target item not found in database
actionTypeNotImplemented: This action type is not yet implemented
noActionChains: No recycling chains defined. Create one to get started.
sellTagInfo: This item is marked as good to sell. It has reasonable value and can be sold to vendors for credits.
